description:
## Goal

Make `PatternDispatchPlan` outcome bindings the sole authority for values a successful inline pattern arm receives. Delete the second bind-only syntax walk that independently reconstructs tuple, list, map, struct, and bitstring projections after dispatch.

## Proven failure and boundary

The production program `metadata() -> %{__fz_local__: 42}; case metadata() do %{__fz_span__: _} -> 0; _ -> 42 end` returns 42 through the interpreter but JIT/AOT fail when native lowering tries to materialize an Absent value. Fresh-base telemetry shows the open map type conservatively retains both runtime arms; this is not a bad reachability decision. The contradiction begins later: the authoritative pattern plan records no outcome binding for wildcard `_`, while `lower_match_clause_block -> bind_pattern -> lower_map_pattern(with_asserts=false)` re-walks the source pattern and emits `RequireMapValue` for every field anyway. RuntimeDemand correctly marks that unused projection `Ignore`/`Nothing`; backend/native still receive the redundant instruction.

This ticket owns the dispatch-outcome-to-arm-binding seam. Inspect and reuse the existing `PatternDispatchPlan.outcomes.bindings`, `PatternSubjectRef`, interpreter/receive subject resolution, inline control-entry parameters, and plan ordering before changing code. The graph remains the sole test/project authority: map value projection is legal only on the key-present edge. Standalone asserting matches may retain their assertion lowering, but successful dispatch arms must not reconstruct plan decisions from syntax.

## Correct model

A pattern plan has one output contract per winning row: its ordered bindings name only source variables/aliases and the exact `PatternSubjectRef` that supplies each value. Wildcards and literal-only subpatterns contribute no binding and therefore no arm parameter, projection instruction, runtime demand, transport lane, or native work. A bound nested value is projected exactly once from the plan-owned subject path after the winning branch established its prerequisites.

Inline `case`, `with`, and `with else` arm environments consume those plan-owned bindings using the same subject/projection vocabulary already used by receive/interpreter execution. Preserve exact source-order outcome selection and contextual variable identity. Do not special-case map wildcards, infer bindings from rendered names, re-walk `Pattern`, or retain both plan bindings and syntax bindings as authorities.

## TDD signal

Pin the standalone reproduction through interpreter, JIT, and AOT: all return 42. Authoritative backend/IR/telemetry proves the wildcard map arm contributes no `RequireMapValue`, runtime lane, materialization, or native work. Add controls where `%{key: value}` binds `value` and where nested tuple/list/map/struct/bitstring variables require exact plan-owned projections; repeated/as-pattern bindings preserve their established diagnostics and values. Cover `case`, `with`, and `with else`, source/clause order, and allocation noise.

Prove the result at the production boundary used by fz-tfn.62: source-less quoted metadata may carry typed syntax metadata without fabricated span metadata, and its impossible-at-runtime span arm passes every execution door. Preserve exact diagnostics for malformed patterns and genuinely missing required keys, all existing dispatch behavior, deterministic artifacts, and causal work counts.

## Strategy and deletion

Start from `PatternDispatchPlan.outcomes.bindings` and route those values into arm environments through existing control-entry/projection mechanisms. Delete `bind_pattern` and its `with_asserts=false` branches if they become unreferenced; keep only assertion construction that has a real non-dispatch consumer. Remove redundant projection steps and downstream demand/transport work rather than padding them.

Do not patch `env_runtime_var`, widen RuntimeDemand, synthesize placeholders, retain impossible/unused lanes, add a native-only exception, second resolver/store/scanner, display-string identity, or compatibility path. Update pattern/dispatch documentation to state the single binding authority. Run focused RED-to-GREEN, library, fixture, CLI, AOT, formatting, check, strict Clippy, deterministic work/allocation gates, and a fresh ticket-scoped cold adversarial review. One ticket, one commit, one close; no construction debris.
title: Make dispatch outcome bindings the sole pattern-projection authority
